narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Halving three times means dividing by six, because two and two and two make six.
<bookmark mark='cuts'/>Each halving divides by two. Three halvings divide by two times two times two.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>That makes eight, not six, so the bubble is wrong.
removed_beats.on_screen: Chintu's bubble shows halving three times means dividing by 6; three halvings are drawn, ÷ 2, ÷ 2, ÷ 2, and joined into ÷ 8; the bubble is struck through in the warning colour

narration: <bookmark mark='think'/>With the same base, divide by taking away the exponents.
